P.name: Pyromania
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Pyromania:}} '''Annie''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'' or casts her other {{tip|abilities}}, stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains ''Energized''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Energized:}} '''Annie''' empowers her next cast of ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'', ''{{ai|Incinerate|Annie}}'', or ''{{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie}}'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to {{tip|stun}} enemies hit for {{pp|1.25;1.5;1.75|1;6;11}} seconds.
P.description3: '''Annie''' gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]].

Q.name: Disintegrate
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
Q.description2: If this kills the target, ''Disintegrate's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50% and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.

W.name: Incinerate
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' releases fire in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

E.name: Molten Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' grants herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and {{ui|Tibbers}} a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 50|key=%}}|movement speed}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: While ''Molten Shield'' is active, enemies that deal damage to it take {{as|magic damage}}. This may only occur once per enemy per cast for each active ''Molten Shield''.

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
R.description3: {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
R.description5: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''

R.name: Summon: Tibbers 2
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
R.description3: {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
R.description5: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''
